reasoning_traces.think:
The system enforces a dual-path truth surface where paid odds form the primary inference layer, and Kalshi acts as a conditional secondary layer. The conditional activation of Kalshi occurs only when paid feed returns no events, i.e., events.length === 0. This creates a logical bifurcation in the truth surface: if paid feed is active, Kalshi is ignored; if inactive, Kalshi is ingested. The paid path computation is hardcoded to use 'the-odds-api' as primary source, ensuring no interference with Kalshi’s role. The thin-fill process verifies Kalshi as a real bookmaker and applies constraints such as minimum bookmakers and sport-specific filtering. These constraints ensure that Kalshi is not merely an overlay but a functional second book. The telemetry fields track runtime behavior and enable retroactive validation of the dual-path logic. Failure modes include: 1) PredExon API errors causing soft-failures; 2) absence of API keys disabling ingestion; 3) incorrect coverage matrix leading to misclassification of Kalshi. Each mode introduces a breakdown in the truth surface, requiring guarded inference.
